eventDetail.scope: The CONCAPAN XLV is a regional conference organized by IEEE Panama Section that covers a broad range of topics in electrical engineering and related fields. Its scope includes power systems, renewable energy integration, power electronics, control and automation, telecommunications, and emerging digital technologies such as artificial intelligence, IoT, and cybersecurity. It also addresses sectoral applications relevant to the region, including electric mobility and critical infrastructure. CONCAPAN XLV brings together academia and industry to foster knowledge exchange, innovation, and professional development aligned with current and future energy and digital challenges.
